commit_message: Complete ADR0126 shared Timeline authoring service
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the shared transactional Timeline authoring mutations required by Sequencer and external authoring surfaces: duration, track/clip rename, typed clip-payload replacement, and marker-event edits. The recovery regenerates the two previously stale exact-match contexts from the rustfmt-formatted target instead of reusing compressed synthetic context.

The PR remains Draft while runtime hardening, Project Rust, Sequencer, and final validation continue.
